about: The trading-hours deploy fence (plans deploy-fence-replacement section 6). A fenced tier may change only outside every [open - pad_before, close + pad_after) window of an XNYS session and outside its blackouts, with at least `need` minutes left before the next window. Holidays and half-day afternoons are open (operator call 1, approved 2026-10-24). A policy change is a version bump with a PR.

superset.about: No session table at all (db, cache and bundled all blind): Mon-Fri, holiday-unaware. It contains every real window, so blindness can only refuse more, never ship into a session.

observer.why: mcp observer-reconcile.py in_rth fences it today: a restart blinds the outside watcher mid-session

pve.why: the observer VM's parent; anything that restarts it blinds the observer

llmbox.why: the copilot reads it during the session; its daily 04:00 stack-pull is outside every window anyway
